page_title: VIL 3-1 OSA | Villarreal v Osasuna 26/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+6' Chimy Avila (Osasuna) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Filip Jorgensen, who smothers the ball.
90+2' Ben Brereton Diaz (Villarreal) is deemed to be in an offside position by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
90' We will have 7 min. of added time.
87' Here is a change. Alfonso Pedraza is going off and Marcelino gives the last tactical orders to Alberto Moreno (Villarreal).
87' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Ben Brereton Diaz (Villarreal) is coming onto the pitch as Jose Luis Morales cannot continue after picking up an injury.
85' A lofted cross from Chimy Avila (Osasuna) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
80' 3 - 1 Jose Luis Morales (Villarreal) receives a delightful pass inside the box and smashes a precise shot inside the left post. What a lovely finish!
79' That's the end of the game for Gerard Moreno, who is replaced by Manu Trigueros (Villarreal).

78' 2 - 1 The ball from the free kick finds its way to Alejandro Catena (Osasuna) who finds himself some space and scores with a thunderous header inside the right post. An incredible long-range header!
77' Jagoba Arrasate has decided to make a change. Jose Manuel Arnaiz (Osasuna) replaces Ante Budimir.
77' Jagoba Arrasate has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Iker Munoz (Osasuna) replacing Lucas Torro.
77' Substitution. Unai Garcia (Osasuna) replaces Aimar Oroz.
77' The resulting set piece from Osasuna is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
75' The Villarreal players are exchanging some short passes.
71' 2 - 0 Goal! After receiving a sweet pass, Jose Luis Morales (Villarreal) unleashes a shot straight into the bottom right corner. Good team effort!
68' It's time for a substitution. Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) comes on in place of Aimar Oroz.
68' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Chimy Avila (Osasuna) comes onto the pitch so that Ruben Pena can be given a rest.
68' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Adria Altimira leaves the pitch and Ilias Akhomach (Villarreal) comes on.
68' Marcelino decides to make a substitution. Etienne Capoue will be replaced by Santi Comesana (Villarreal).
65' One of the Osasuna players was holding his opponent and the referee doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
64' Substitution. Jon Moncayola walks off the pitch and Raul (Osasuna) comes on as a substitute.
63' Villarreal can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
61' One of the Villarreal players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
57' 1 - 0 Goal! Jose Luis Morales (Villarreal) finishes from close range with an easy finish and he makes it 1:0. He was ably assisted there by Gerard Moreno.
57' The corner is swung in but Villarreal can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
56' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Alfonso Pedraza (Villarreal), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
55' Osasuna have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
54' Jose Luis Morales (Villarreal) is penalised for holding. Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea signals a set piece.
50' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Aimar Oroz (Osasuna), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches wide of the left post.
49' Ruben Pena (Osasuna) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
49' Lucas Torro (Osasuna) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+1' Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45' Villarreal take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
44' PENALTY APPEAL by Osasuna, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!
42' Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) climbs high to connect with a cross heading towards the edge of the box and produces a poor header which goes well wide of the right post.
36' Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
35' Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar.
33' Lucas Torro (Osasuna) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly low towards the middle of the goal, but Filip Jorgensen is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
31' A rebound spins to Ruben Pena (Osasuna) inside the box, but his sliced shot flies just wide of the right post.
27' A pass by Juan Foyth (Villarreal) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
25' A sweeping move ends with a pass to Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) inside the box. He lets fly towards the middle of the goal, but Filip Jorgensen was watching it all the way and makes a comfortable save.
25' Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
24' A clumsy foul by Juan Foyth (Villarreal) and Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea blows his whistle.
20' Dani Parejo (Villarreal) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
16' Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
16' Osasuna quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
15' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
14' Villarreal are ruled offside.
12' David Garcia (Osasuna) knocks his opponent down with an over-the-top tackle.

10' Filip Jorgensen makes a sensational save to thwart a great chance. A rebound falls to Ante Budimir (Osasuna) inside the box and he drills a strike goalwards, but the ball ends up in the keeper's gloves instead of the middle of the target.
9' The ball is laid off to Ruben Pena (Osasuna) on the edge of the box. He shoots through a crowd of players towards the left side of the goal and forces Filip Jorgensen to make a decent save.
6' Juan Foyth (Villarreal) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
3' A clever short pass gives Ante Budimir (Osasuna) a clear goal scoring opportunity, but he fluffs his lines and rifles the ball high over the bar.
2' Great teamplay by Osasuna as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Villarreal will kick the game off.
Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea will supervise the game today.
